newsitem.title: UK: American Pimas lead cotton prices higher in Europe.
newsitem.headline: American Pimas lead cotton prices higher in Europe.

text.p: Prices for American long staple cottons in Europe were up by over one cent per lb as new buyers entered the market for Pima grades, industry sources said.
Turkish Adanas realised increases of 1.5 cents, also on signs of fresh demand.

Central Asian cottons were firmed despite the low volumes traded as buyers continue to cover gaps in nearby requirements but the recent tendency for sellers to inflate their asking prices has kept interest in delivery dates beyond the first quarter of 1997 closeted.
